description: Saved UEA joint-effect benchmark analysis; no training rerun.
highlight_selection: Post hoc: GCS BA exceeds GP or Standard BA in uea-full. Descriptive only; all statistics use all 18.

statistical_method.test: Two-sided Wilcoxon signed-rank with exact sign-permutation distribution; average tied ranks, discard zero differences
statistical_method.rounding: Differences rounded to 12 decimal places before ranking
statistical_method.multiplicity: Holm adjustment across the 16 BA comparisons
statistical_method.replication: One seed and one published split per dataset
statistical_method.saved_intervals: 95% paired stratified bootstrap over held-out cases, unadjusted per-dataset intervals; 1000 draws
statistical_method.implementation_checked_against: scipy.stats.wilcoxon with exhaustive PermutationMethod on four fixtures including ties and zeros
statistical_method.descriptive_ranks: Average tied ranks after rounding BA to 12 decimals. Joint-effect analysis ranks GI, GP, and GCS only; four-method ranks including Standard are retained separately for reference.

confidence_reference_probe.scope: Current source on one five-reading/two-channel fixture; does not prove the cause in archived runs
